## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests for the requirement are named with its ID
- [ ] New UI text is in both `en` and `es`
- [ ] Checked at phone width
- [ ] No real financial data in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] New dependencies are explained here, with their license
